description.en:
Shows (true) or hides (false) an object: character, model, map, image, camera... The first argument can also be an array of handles.
For a character of the event's character list whose name appears twice in that list, the setting is also stored in the list. For objects of kind 5 (the upper 16 bits of the handle equal 5), the object itself is kept hidden and only the list entry receives the setting (not traced further).
Object handle, or an array of handles.
true (or non-zero) to show, false to hide.

null in every case: after a change, and also when an object is not found (for an array, the handles after an unknown one are not changed), the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
